title: Add-on manifest, api_version 2
description: Served publicly at GET /addon/api/manifest. The site validates it (backend/app/core/addons.py `parse_manifest`) and drops the whole manifest when anything is off. The add-on never knows the key the site gave it, so every path is add-on-relative (/addon/<file>); the site rewrites it to /addon/<key>/<file>. Who may use an entry is decided by the site (enabled flag and access list), not by this document.

api_version.description: Contract version; the site refuses any other value.

entries.description: The screens this add-on offers. Ids must be unique within the manifest (checked by the site; JSON Schema here only bounds the size).

id.description: Entry id, unique in the manifest; the site's per-entry routes use it (/api/v1/addons/<id>/me).

version.description: Version of the add-on that serves this entry.

name.description: Menu and tab label, per language.

description.description: One sentence shown in the site's Administration dialog, per language.

element.description: Custom element the site mounts for this entry. It receives the attributes lang, active and base (the add-on's public path, /addon/<key>/).

capabilities.description: Where the element may be mounted: a workshop-style tab, or a map layer.

path.description: Add-on-relative public path, no '..' and no '//'.
